newsitem.title: POLAND: ZEW says flood damage exceeds PLN 50 mln.
newsitem.headline: ZEW says flood damage exceeds PLN 50 mln.

text.p: Poland's electrode maker ZEW SA incurred losses exceeding 50 million zlotys due to floods which hit southern Poland and will receive full compensation from its insurer, ZEW president said on Friday.

"Hestia Insurance SA, in which ZEW has been insured since 1994, estimated preliminary losses incurred by the firm at around 50 million zlotys. In my opinion, they will be larger," Jerzy Szpineter said.
The exact numbers would be published on August 6, he added.
"On August 6, we will present precise losses in a report for the stock exchange," Szpineter said. @
He added that then the company would publish its June financial results which had been delayed by the flood.
STU Hestia Insurance SA deputy president said the firm had already received 10 million zlotys through a special advance payment.
